blade.composition: Opaque union of each curved lobe and blade_cover polygons; preserve concave silhouette. Do NOT take a convex hull. Geometry2D.MergePolygons or independent opaque draws with one union outline.

shaft.station_mapping: (axis_distance,half_width_px), monotone-sort valid stations; interpolate smoothstep; draw upper/lower sampled silhouette, NOT a constant-width DrawLine rectangle

inner_light_geometry.paired_indices: i=1..35 outer=blade[i]; innerCurve=[blade[0]]+reverse(blade[37..71])+[blade[36]]; interpolate innerPoint at the same dot(point,axis) as outer
inner_light_geometry.closure: root, 28-percent edge in forward order, tip, 72-percent edge in reverse order
inner_light_geometry.note: Opaque light band only within the curved blade; pairing the same Bezier parameter is invalid for the deep notch. Match axial position, never scale about the centroid or fill the notch.

color_layers.note: glow is optional soft edge only; the core replacing the old axe must remain opaque

limitations: Reference is heavily glowing and partly out of frame; these are interpreted 2D contours, not an exact full silhouette tracing.
Do not use a more attractive Pillow-only preview as proof the Godot runtime was changed.
Original cover masks can still produce local protrusions; fix frame metadata rather than hide those errors with excessive glow.
